other_conditions: Benefit limited to the first two live deliveries
Hospitals must have a minimum of 10 inpatient beds
Hospitals must have a functional operation theatre and delivery room
24‑hour availability of gynecologists, anesthetists and pediatricians is required
Hospitals must have a linkage with blood banks
The District Health Officer identifies eligible hospitals and invites them for partnership
benefits_summary: Cashless delivery services (including normal and complicated deliveries) up to the first two live births for BPL women at registered private hospitals in Karnataka.
